title: Make the high-risk execution-gate refusal state its own cause
action: In set_gate.rs the merged/named execution gate approval has two guard arms that fire when the target record's mode is 'high-risk': the silent peek arm (~line 494-500) and the post-lock race arm (~line 507-511). Both currently `return Err(Err2::Ex)`, which the dispatcher renders as `bee: unsupported argument shape`, telling the caller their flags are wrong when the flags are correct. Replace BOTH with a real refusal carrying a message, emitted the same way the other refusals in this handler are (`return Ok(Out::Thrown(msg))`). The message must state: (1) what was refused and that NOTHING was written; (2) the real cause -- a high-risk execution approval requires a fresh advisor consult, and that precondition (requireFreshAdvisorForHighRisk) is unported R6 debt, so the arm currently refuses every high-risk execution approval unconditionally rather than checking advisor_ref; (3) that `bee state advisor-ref record` is declared-but-not-built, so this refusal cannot be satisfied from the CLI today, and the approval therefore has to come from the human or wait on that port. Name the lane/feature in the message. Do NOT change what is refused -- the gate must still refuse; only the honesty of the refusal changes. Keep both arms' behaviour identical to each other.

truths: The gate still refuses every high-risk execution approval -- this cell changes the message, never the verdict
Nothing is written on the refusal path, exactly as before
artifacts: A test asserting the refusal message names the high-risk cause and is NOT the unsupported-argument-shape kind
prohibitions: Do not port requireFreshAdvisorForHighRisk in this cell
Do not make any high-risk gate approvable
Do not touch any file other than set_gate.rs and its test module

verify: cargo test --release -p bee state_group -- --nocapture, plus a manual probe: `bee state gate --lane <a high-risk lane> --merge --approved true --json` must return a refusal whose text names the advisor precondition and whose kind is not unsupported_argument_shape.

trace.outcome: Both high-risk execution-gate refusal arms now return Out::Thrown with a message naming the advisor-consult cause instead of the generic Err2::Ex unsupported-argument-shape path
